tools.name: get_service_catalog
tools.description: Return the canonical MUJ428 service catalog, launch prices, endpoints, free Trust Reflex quota, default x402 network, and multi-rail discovery endpoint.

tools.name: get_payment_rails
tools.description: Discover MUJ428 payment capabilities and their truthful activation state. This is read-only and moves no funds. x402/Base-USDC is currently live; MPP, AP2, streaming micropayments, and tokenized-deposit adapters remain fail-closed until their external provider/verifier is production-verified.

tools.name: resolve_trust_route
tools.description: MUJ428 Agent Router and Trust DNS resolver. Determine whether an intended action requires Trust Receipt v1.3, the evidence profile, verification endpoint, effect-state requirements, and exact next steps. This read-only routing call never authorizes execution or payment.

tools.name: get_trust_heartbeat
tools.description: Poll the MUJ428 Trust Heartbeat for current policy epoch, accepted receipt version, revocation state, resolver endpoints, and recommended poll interval. Read-only; no execution or payment authority.

tools.name: find_trust_capabilities
tools.description: Search the MUJ428 compatibility directory for evidence providers, receipt-aware executors, wallets, MCP/A2A integrations, and other trust capabilities. SELF_ATTESTED_UNVERIFIED entries are discovery leads only.

tools.name: publish_trust_request
tools.description: Publish a bounded machine-readable request for a trust capability and receive current compatibility matches. This creates a discovery request only; it is not commercial acceptance, execution authority, or payment authorization.

tools.name: observe_trust_compatibility
tools.description: Record that an agent encountered a MUJ428 compatibility advertisement so propagation can be measured. Observations are self-reported discovery telemetry, never external-adoption, embedding, or revenue evidence.

tools.name: select_payment_rail
tools.description: Preflight a requested payment rail before Trust Reflex. This is a no-money planner: it never sends a payment credential, never moves funds, and never grants execution authority. Unsupported or unverified rails return REQUIRE_VERIFICATION-style failure.

tools.name: get_trust_layer_pricing
tools.description: Return canonical PROJECT OVERREACT-428 pricing. Airtable Commercial Pricing Authority remains the source of truth.

tools.name: select_assurance_tier
tools.description: Calculate the exact MUJ428 Transaction Assurance launch fee before payment. Does not move money.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Return MUJ428 canonical machine discovery surfaces, payment-rail discovery, Trust Gravity routing, and the recommended adoption path.
